package_info.package_versions: unknown, affected via compromised update channel
package_info.why_malicious: The update mechanism of the NoxPlayer Android emulator was compromised to deliver malware as part of a supply-chain attack (Operation NightScout), targeting millions of users in online-gaming communities across Asia. The malicious payload was distributed through legitimate software updates, enabling espionage and unauthorized access.

execution_context.file_location: NoxPlayer update package (delivered via official update channel)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Malicious payload delivered via NoxPlayer update mechanism, which downloads and executes additional malware binaries from attacker-controlled servers.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: During update-time, the code downloads additional malware from attacker-controlled servers, writes it to disk, and executes it, enabling remote access and espionage.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Legitimate update mechanisms should only deliver authentic, signed updates from trusted sources. Downloading and executing arbitrary binaries from external servers is a hallmark of supply-chain attacks.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal update behavior involves downloading verified, signed updates from the official vendor. In this case, the update mechanism was abused to deliver malware.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Software updaters legitimately download and install updates, but only from trusted, verified sources.
key_indicators: Update mechanism downloads from non-standard or attacker-controlled domains
Execution of unsigned or unexpected binaries post-update
No user consent or notification for additional payload execution

attack_chain.action: Compromise NoxPlayer update infrastructure to deliver malicious update packages.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious payload is delivered to user systems.

attack_chain.action: Malicious update downloads and executes additional malware from attacker-controlled servers.
attack_chain.leads_to: Establishes persistence, enables espionage, and potentially further lateral movement.

behavioral_signatures: Update process downloads and executes binaries from non-official domains
Unexpected process execution immediately after software update
Network connections to attacker-controlled infrastructure during or after update
file_indicators: Unexpected binaries written to disk by the update process
Presence of files not included in official update manifests
network_indicators: Connections to domains/IPs not associated with official NoxPlayer infrastructure
Outbound traffic to known C2 or suspicious remote servers during update
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor update processes for unexpected network activity, especially downloads from non-official domains. Check for execution of unsigned or unexpected binaries post-update. Validate update package signatures and compare file hashes against known-good versions. Alert on any new files or processes spawned by the update mechanism that are not part of the official update.
